title: Multi-omics and experimental validation identify methylation-related genes and METTL16 as key regulators in diabetic foot ulcer pathogenesis.
summary: LASSO, gradient boosting, SVM-RFE and random forest selected methylation-related biomarkers from diabetic-foot-ulcer datasets, and the candidates were connected to single-cell analysis and METTL16 fibroblast assays under hyperglycemic stress. The work identified methylation-associated regulators in diabetic-foot-ulcer pathogenesis. Conclusions remain limited to the reported cohorts and experiments.
